_about: Indicative crop calendar and growing belts for Madhya Pradesh, used only to raise review flags (never to change a limit). seasons = normal; rare = grown but uncommon (medium flag); any other season = implausible (high flag). districts '*' = grown across the state. District lists are indicative belts, not exhaustive; an officer can override a low flag.

_sources.calendar: MP Kisan Kalyan tatha Krishi Vikas Vibhag, https://mpkrishi.mp.gov.in (standard kharif / rabi / zaid calendar). General agronomy, not district-verified.
_sources.cotton: https://www.data.gov.in/catalog/district-wise-cotton-farming-area-madhya-pradesh ; https://www.chinimandi.com/?p=336627 (Indore division belt: Khargone, Khandwa, Barwani, Dhar, Ratlam, Dewas)
_sources.moong: https://www.downtoearth.org.in/agriculture/heatwaves-and-summer-moong-cultivation-arent-going-well-in-madhya-pradeshs-narmadapuram ; https://india.mongabay.com/2023/08/mp-farmers-burn-the-stubble-from-rabi-harvest-to-grow-a-third-crop-before-kharif/ (summer moong in Narmadapuram, Harda, Sehore, Raisen)
_sources.soybean: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soybean Research, Indore, https://iisrindore.icar.gov.in (kharif crop, MP is the largest producer)

maize.note: Rabi maize is rare in MP

mustard.note: Main belt Gwalior-Chambal, smaller area across the state

sugarcane.note: Annual crop; a kharif or rabi entry usually means the planting season was given

onion.note: Main crop rabi, late-kharif onion also grown
